v01: A plain N F C sticker holds five hundred and four bytes.
v02: That's room for a whole song.
v03: N F C Cartridges, for Flipper Zero.
v04: Pick a song, then hold a blank sticker to the back.
v05: It burns the tune on, page by page, in under two seconds.
v06: Ode to Joy takes a hundred bytes.
v07: Nothing goes on the S D card. The song is a standard [NDEF](/ˈɛndɛf/) text record, so phones can read it too.
v08: It writes the length last, so a torn burn reads as blank, never half a song.
v09: Then it reads the sticker back and checks every byte.
v10: Tap it in Play, and the Flipper plays it straight off the sticker.
v11: It burns [N-tag](/ˈɛntæɡ/) two-thirteen, two-fifteen and two-sixteen stickers, from a short jingle to two hundred and fifty notes.
v12: N F C Cartridges. Songs that live on a sticker.
